channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. item.title: What We Can Learn from Democrat's 'Blue-Nami'
item.itunes:title: What We Can Learn from Democrat's 'Blue-Nami'
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Democrats retook both the House and Senate after romping through multiple deep-red states in a historic midterm election. Is this a product of President Donald Trump’s historic unpopularity, or a more fundamental reshaping of our politics? We take stock of the map and how Democrats could approach being in the majority for the final two years of Trump’s term. 

--- 

Guest: David Chalian, CNN Washington Bureau Chief/Political Director 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: Split Ticket Voters: The Mood in Michigan
item.itunes:title: Split Ticket Voters: The Mood in Michigan
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Election Day voting is underway across the country, with control of the House and Senate on the line. We check in on a polling place in Michigan, where some voters are splitting their ticket amid Democratic drama in the key Senate race.

--- 

Guest: Sunlen Serfaty, CNN Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Nicky Robertson

item.title: Private Jet Nosedives into Road in Florida
item.description: President Donald Trump wrapped up his midterm campaign with closing remarks at the Reflecting Pool. Some House Republicans are privately pushing to boot Rep. Haley Stevens after her controversial endorsement switch. Rain could impact voter turnout in key races. Federal investigators are trying to determine the cause of a fiery crash in Florida that left behind a massive crater. And, a judge in the Lindsay Clancy triple-murder trial has proposed a timeline for a potential retrial. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices
